target.statement: Every finite bridgeless simple graph G has a multiset of simple cycles covering every edge with total length at most (7/5)|E(G)|.

local_exact_target_coverage: results/expansion/formal_conjectures.md classifies the declaration but performs no cycle-cover trial
results/expansion/method_v02_upstream_selection.md excludes it from the earlier fixed-invariant sweep

literature_gate.known_wall: The Petersen graph has 15 edges and shortest cycle-cover length 21, attaining 7/5.
literature_gate.known_equalities: Published work gives infinite cubic equality families of cyclic connectivity 2 and 3.
references: N. Alon and M. Tarsi, Covering multigraphs by simple circuits, SIAM J. Algebraic Discrete Methods 6 (1985), DOI 10.1137/0606035
E. Macajova and M. Skoviera, Cubic Graphs with No Short Cycle Covers, SIAM J. Discrete Math. 35 (2021), DOI 10.1137/21M1399208

semantics.invariant: scc(G), minimum total length of a multiset of simple cycles covering E(G)
semantics.optimization: binary set cover over all undirected simple cycles; positive costs make duplicate cycles unnecessary
semantics.integrality_guard: accept only solver success with objective within 1e-7 of an integer

database_gate.graphs: all connected Graph Atlas graphs on 2..7 vertices that are bridgeless, plus C5..C9, P7, Petersen, K3,3, K7, stars K1,2..K1,6, and complete bipartite K2,3/K2,4/K3,3
database_gate.expected: all applicable controls have R>=0; inapplicable controls are logged

family.transformation: replace edge (0,1) by a path with t new degree-two vertices
family.label_roles: original vertices p0..p9; subdivision path x1..xt from p0 to p1

prediction.residual: 2t (increase exactly; moves away from the wall)
prediction.controlling_identity: suppressing the degree-two path maps every cover to a Petersen cover; an automorphic image of a length-21 Petersen cover covers the selected edge once

stop_rules: any failed microfixture => GATE_FAIL and no family rows
any applicable database residual below zero => CORRUPT_OR_ERRATUM and no family rows
any timeout => TIMEOUT_BRACKET for that row, with no guessed objective
no alternative base edge, base graph, operation, or t-range may be substituted
